briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Michigan Growers Rack Up Trophies While D.C. and Lansing Both Bend Toward Relief
briefs.top: Michigan's cultivators just took home the state's biggest cannabis trophies and posted a record sales year even as the 24% wholesale tax squeezes margins — and now a gubernatorial candidate is courting the industry with a repeal pledge. Nationally, psychedelics cleared a major FDA milestone and cannabis M&A is heating up, while medical marijuana's Schedule III move survived a court challenge — real momentum for operators willing to read past the tax headlines.
